integrity: The all-set characterization is proved from the shortest-path definition, independently corroborated by exhaustive path-assignment search, and compared against the published complete-multipartite minimum-value theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes at least two partite sets and every part has size at least two.
Singleton partite sets are outside the proved scope.
The exhaustive path-assignment verification covers total order at most ten; the all-orders result is proved symbolically.
Targeted literature searches cannot exclude differently phrased or non-indexed prior classifications.
title: All strong edge geodetic sets of complete multipartite graphs
